LTTH Version 1.3.28 Release Notes

Version 1.3.28 bundles the disabled Visual FX Frame WEBGPU beta with the runtime, keeps its subscriber open-beta store package available, and resets Goals exactly once for each confirmed TikTok LIVE stream.

- NEW: Visual FX Frame WEBGPU 1.2.0 ships as an independent disabled working beta for WebGPU-capable OBS browser sources
- FIXED: Goals reset once per confirmed stream identity and ignore reconnects to the same LIVE room
- IMPROVED: Launcher defaults use high contrast, remain open, and follow the Stable update channel
- IMPROVED: Public release metadata and download surfaces bumped to 1.3.28
